Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, J.B. PARDIWALA, MANOJ MISRA
Issue for Consideration Whether Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA) has a right to contest an appeal against its order determining tariff for aeronautical services before Telecom Disputes Settlement and and then consequently prefer an appeal against the order of TDSAT before this Court under Section 31 of the Airport Economic Regulatory Authority Act, 2008; and Even if AERA does not have a right to contest an appeal against its order determining tariff for aeronautical services before TDSAT,
Decision Date : 18-10-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3098/2023 | Direction Issue : Matters directed to be listed before the Regular Bench. | Bench : 3 Judges
